title: Ryan
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds of 7 muscle-ups and 21 burpees, for time. Honours Maplewood, Missouri, firefighter Ryan Hummert, 22, shot by a sniper while responding to a call in 2008. Scale muscle-ups to 7 pull-ups plus 7 ring dips per round.
